dogecoin.text: It's really quite surprising how much effort people go to when they are trying to trash $XVG, but seriously, some of the arguments are laughable. "Did you know Verge started as DogeCoin Dark?" Well, did you know Google started as BackRub? I think it shows progress and foresight.

@theMAVN @worldphotostory How can you say it will never work for privacy. If I'm not mistaken $XVG exceeds all other currencies for the level of privacy it offers. The Dogecoin Dark argument is so weak, I've already said before that it was a sensible rebranding just like when Google changed from Backrub.
